title: {{NAME}} and the Dinosaur Who Found a Unicorn Egg
moral: Taking care of something small is one of the best things you can do.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked through a misty valley. Pink clouds floated low in the sky. Strange colourful plants grew everywhere. Then he saw a large blue dinosaur. The dinosaur was looking at something on the ground.

pages.content: The dinosaur had found an egg. It was white with gold and purple swirls. It glowed a little. The dinosaur did not know what to do with it. He nudged it gently with his nose.

pages.content: {{NAME}} knew the egg needed to stay warm. He gathered soft leaves. The big dinosaur curled around the egg. They sat together and kept it safe. They waited and waited.

pages.content: The egg began to crack. Gold light burst from the cracks. The dinosaur held very still. {{NAME}} held his breath. A tiny, wet, wobbly baby unicorn popped out of the egg!

pages.content: The baby unicorn nuzzled the dinosaur's nose. The dinosaur was her first friend. Taking care of something small is one of the best things you can do. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep well. The baby unicorn had a tiny glow around her horn. What magic would she do first?
